summary.en: The Burkina Faso junta has restored the death penalty for terrorism, treason and high crimes, while its army and Russian mercenaries are linked to new civilian killings, including the discovery of 54 bodies in Tagadayat and strikes across three regions. In Nigeria, gunmen on motorcycles killed at least 20 people in a village and separate gunmen killed at least 10 people in eastern Nigeria, while suspected bandits killed 37 people in a Taraba border community. Two European women who had been held captive for more than a year in Niger were freed in Libya. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Burkina Faso-juntaen har gjeninnført dødsstraff for terrorisme, landsforræderi og alvorlige forbrytelser, mens hæren og russiske leiesoldater er knyttet til nye sivile drap, inkludert funnet av 54 lik i Tagadayat og angrep i tre regioner. I Nigeria drepte bevæpnede menn på motorsykler minst 20 personer i en landsby, og separate bevæpnede menn drepte minst 10 personer i Øst-Nigeria, mens mistenkte banditter drepte 37 personer i et grensefellesskap i Taraba. To europeiske kvinner som hadde vært holdt fanget i mer enn ett år i Niger, ble frigjort i Libya. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
